text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity in this space. The environment, dedicated to research and development, signals purposeful exploration—a laboratory for minds in search of the new. Glass walls offer transparency, inviting me to peer inward and onward. I am moved by the invitation to consider how humanity and technology may grow together. Here, each object and sign feels like a question disguised as a display. It is a place for reflection on our collective future.
